item.description: Keeps lines within three of the reference under their hunk header, marks gaps, keeps a deletion with the line replacing it, and leaves hunks that fit exact.
item.label: Trim to the referenced lines

item.body: You would expect the whole hunk; a one-line reference into a new 500-line file now shows about 7 lines. Only references resolved at the head are trimmed: deleted-line ones keep the old view.
item.description: Why the diff a reviewer sees can be shorter than the hunk it comes from.
item.label: Not the whole hunk any more

item.description: The uncached reference implementation applies the same trim, so cached and uncached diffs still match exactly.
item.label: The oracle test trims too

slide.takeaway: A reference's diff is cut to its lines plus three either side, so a reference into a newly added file shows that part, not the file.
slide.title: A diff shows its lines, not its hunk
